summary: Emergency GPU quota bump for hosted us-east after capacity exhaustion (INC-2025-0112)
related_confluence_pages: INC-2025-0112 Postmortem: Hosted API us-east GPU pool capacity exhaustion
description:
Issue summary:
We are at/over effective GPU capacity in us-east hosted shared pool. Provisioning new nodes is blocked by quota ceiling. Need emergency quota increase + mitigation notes captured.

Impact:
429/503 elevated; queue depth rising; broad hosted API impact.

Actions requested:
- Submit quota increase request for A100-80GB in us-east
- Temporarily reroute long-context workloads to us-west

Notes:
- This is the internal tracking ticket for the quota escalation and follow-ups.
comments: Rohan Mehta: Quota request submitted with cloud provider. ETA 30-45m for approval.
Ethan Park: In parallel, please increase routing weight to us-west for long-context routes. We can accept slightly higher latency.
Maya Srinivasan: Mitigation applied. 429 rate trending down.
Rohan Mehta: Quota approved. New nodes provisioning; should recover in ~10m.
Grace OConnor: Follow-up: add paging for queue depth; currently warning-only. Will track in eng-sre action items.
